articles.summary: Miracle is partnering with Odyssey Therapeutics to power a groundbreaking Phase 2a ulcerative colitis study with real‑time data integration, unifying clinical trial systems to accelerate execution, enhance safety monitoring, and advance next‑generation inflammatory disease treatments.
articles.title: Partnering with Odyssey Therapeutics to Transform Ulcerative Colitis Treatment

articles.summary: This article introduces Miracle’s Real-Time Alerts, a new capability that gives clinical trial teams instant, customizable visibility across all their data, overcoming disconnected systems, static thresholds, and alert noise, to enable proactive, data-driven oversight and faster decision-making.
articles.title: From Reactive to Proactive: How Real-Time Alerts in Miracle Keep Clinical Trials on Track
